scripts.check: turbo run lint typecheck test build
scripts.db:migrate: turbo run build --filter=@spatial/db^... && pnpm --filter @spatial/db run migrate
scripts.db:status: turbo run build --filter=@spatial/db^... && pnpm --filter @spatial/db run status
scripts.db:seed: turbo run build --filter=@spatial/api && pnpm --filter @spatial/api run seed
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build --wait && turbo run build --filter=@spatial/dev-infra^... && pnpm --filter @spatial/dev-infra run init
scripts.infra:check: turbo run build --filter=@spatial/dev-infra^... && pnpm --filter @spatial/dev-infra run check
scripts.infra:llm: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --profile local-llm up -d --wait ollama
scripts.infra:llm:models: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --profile local-llm exec ollama sh /modelfiles/create-models.sh
